top_categories.workout_context: Eroica California's mixed pavement and dirt — Central Coast forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 107 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Eroica California's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
Eroica California's mixed pavement and dirt — Central Coast rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
At mile 60 of 107, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
At Eroica California, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Eroica California. Train it until it feels boring.
When someone attacks on mixed pavement and dirt — Central Coast, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Eroica California, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 107 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Eroica California's mixed pavement and dirt — Central Coast actually does to you.
Varied gradients on mixed pavement and dirt — Central Coast demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed pavement and dirt — Central Coast. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Eroica California’s 107 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Eroica California. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Highly technical terrain at Eroica California demands practice on similar surfaces. Ride mixed pavement and dirt — central coast coastal/inland at race-day cadence weekly. Practice cornering, descending, and power delivery on unstable surfaces. Test tires and pressure in comparable conditions before race week rather than guessing from a generic time-loss claim.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 107 miles of mixed pavement and dirt — central coast coastal/inland in Cambria, Central Coast, California, USA.
